description.intro: KT Tape Pro Extreme kinesiology tape is designed to provide durable support to muscles and joints even in extreme conditions. It is suitable for athletes who train in high humidity, heat or oily skin environments, providing relief and protection without limiting movement.
key_benefits: Extra strong adhesive: Maintains attachment even in moisture, sweat or intense heat.
Longer duration: Effective between 4 and 7 days in a row.
Visibilidad extra: Detalles reflectantes que aumentan la seguridad en la actividad.
